INHERITANCE RECOVERY GUIDE

Wallet: Family Vault (demo)

For: Alex Rivera
Contact: Sam — sam@example.com

1. Find 2 of the 3 signing keys.
Fingerprints: 4BA43603, 8DFC9B34, 56C4FAC3
Demo only:
• Signer 1: home safe.
• Signer 2: separate backup held by Sam.
• Signer 3: Alex's device.

Match their fingerprints.

2. Additional instructions (optional).
A copy of this kit is with Sam. Arrange access to two signers using our separately stored instructions. No passwords are included here.

3. Open the official Nunchuk app from https://nunchuk.io. Import the wallet descriptor below. Compare its network and first receive address before continuing.

4. Connect enough supported hardware signers to meet the threshold. Follow Nunchuk's recovery instructions: https://resources.nunchuk.io/wallet-recovery/personal-wallet/

5. Rehearse with the owner first. Never type seed words into a website or share them with support.
